purpose: Prevent finite eta-wise Q_p first-hit diagnostics from being promoted to a full-eta matching-boundary existence, uniqueness, regularity, Cartesian bridge, or global velocity-delivery claim.

bindings.independent_audit_role: implementation-distinct finite-probe scalar-transport audit only; not full-eta target-boundary evidence

user_requirement: Deliver an explicit callable and save-loadable velocity(x,y,z,t)->[u,v,w] without treating PDE validation as a prerequisite for callability.
Keep velocity delivery, visual correspondence, PDE validation, paper exactness, and OpenAI-field identification as independent states.
public_source_fact: The corrected reconstruction includes a post-release2 l=-h matching stage and states that the radial matching quantity is carried until the already-defined terminal target Q_p is reached.

The public matching-stage statement does not by itself certify this repository current candidate's full-eta target-hit existence, a unique smooth eta-dependent hit-time map, or a Cartesian terminal-boundary realization.
autonomous_design: PR #1233 materializes the current carried inhomogeneous l=-h Q_s(y,eta) transport and a deterministic pointwise target-time diagnostic using fixed bracket expansion and bisection.
PR #1233's default target report and A4 #1237's held-out target-time checks are finite eta samples; they are diagnostics, not a continuum/full-eta certificate.
This CR002 contract requires target-totality and regularity evidence before a pointwise diagnostic may become an eta-dependent delivery representation.
pending_unknown: Whether Q_s_entry(eta)>Q_p holds on the full applicable eta interval for the exact current #1233 identity.
Whether every applicable eta has a finite nonnegative first hit of Q_p and whether that hit is unique with a branch definition stable under eta variation.
Whether a uniformly transverse or otherwise explicitly regularized eta->T(eta) target-time map exists and is smooth enough for a Cartesian matching boundary, including endpoint/axis behavior.

Any current Cartesian matching bridge, terminal multiplier composition, exterior/global leading completion, matched pressure, restricted forcing, complete NS residual, visual correspondence, PDE validation, paper exactness, or OpenAI-field identity.

promotion_prerequisites: Bind the exact applicable eta interval and establish a full-interval target-entry condition sufficient for a nonnegative hit, such as a certified positive margin Q_s_entry(eta)-Q_p>0, or document an alternative rigorous branch/existence argument.
Establish the target-root branch on the full eta interval: prove uniqueness of the intended first hit or explicitly define and justify branch selection if multiple roots can occur.

Establish target regularity needed by the chosen representation, including nondegenerate/transverse crossing D_y Q_s!=0 where an implicit eta->T(eta) map is used, or explicitly handle any degeneracy/singularity rather than sampling through it.
Establish continuity/smoothness and endpoint/axis semantics of eta->T(eta) before calling it an eta-dependent Cartesian boundary; finite eta samples or a smooth-looking plot are insufficient.

Compose either a separately justified common scalar bridge or an explicit eta-dependent boundary into the Cartesian velocity, create a new semantic/save-load identity, and replay finite-value, seam, axis, and claimed project-domain coverage checks.
Keep canonical Eq45 callability and visual/PDE/paper/OpenAI states independent throughout; no matching-boundary result alone promotes any of those scientific states.

mechanics_witness.claim: A finite set can show valid nonnegative target hits while an unsampled eta has q_entry<Q_p and therefore no nonnegative hit under a monotone decaying bridge. This is representation logic only, not Kokuno/OpenAI numerical evidence.
